entities.summary: Afghan, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Safavid Empire (1629–1736). Preceded by Safavid Decline and Fall and Safavid forces recapture Baghdad from the Ottomans. Their legacy influenced Nadir Shah sacks Delhi and seizes the Peacock Throne and Koh-i-Noor diamond.
